persons.name: canonical full name as best known in English transliteration
aliases: kunya / nom de guerre / alt spellings mentioned
persons.role: position/title at the time discussed (e.g. 'Taliban interior minister', 'al-Qaeda general manager')
persons.nationality_or_origin: e.g. Afghan, Pakistani, Egyptian, Saudi; '' if unknown
persons.status_detail: e.g. 'killed in US drone strike in Kabul 31 Jul 2022'
locations: places this person is associated with in this episode

places.significance: why it comes up in this episode

events.date: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM or YYYY or 'approx 2021'

sources_cited: documents/reports the hosts cite, e.g. 'UN Monitoring Team 34th report', 'US Treasury designation'
key_claims: 3-8 one-sentence analytic claims the hosts make about the network (who shelters whom, who controls what, etc.)
